fflate

Author: Arjun Barrett and contributors.
Upstream: https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate
License: MIT. Complete notice: dist/licenses/fflate-LICENSE.txt.
The unchanged browser ES module is dist/vendor/fflate.module.js.
SOURCE.json records the exact npm distribution and verified file digests.
Only gunzipSync is used, when native gzip decompression is unavailable.
No remote script, extra worker or external service is started by this path.
